R13_train_only_hp_selection.hp_choice: the configuration with the lowest score
R13_train_only_hp_selection.hp_score: mean held-out TRAIN NLL across 3 seeds x 2 folds

refit_step_rule.inputs: s_A and s_B, the selected scheduled steps for (c*, seed) on folds A and B; each is a multiple of 1000
refit_step_rule.why_ceil: the mean of two multiples of 1000 can land on a half-multiple; ceiling to the next 1000 is unambiguous and needs no half-rounding convention
refit_step_rule.why_not_rescaled: optimizer STEPS, not epochs, are the frozen budget unit; the refit therefore takes the same number of gradient updates while drawing from a 2x larger pool, which is the conservative choice

calibration_diagnostics.ECE_bin_convention: p in [lower, upper); the last bin is closed on the right
calibration_diagnostics.calibration_intercept_and_slope: minimize over (a, b) the SAME frozen grouped Bernoulli NLL with logit z replaced by a + b z; perfect calibration is (a, b) = (0, 1); it degenerates to standard Cox calibration at R = 1
calibration_diagnostics.observation_pairs: (q_{e,c,i}, t_{e,c} = k/R) at ROBOT level with weight 1/(2 N_e E), which reproduces the frozen loss weighting exactly
calibration_diagnostics.role: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY -- never a selector or a tie-breaker

excluded_from_the_primary_preregistratio: any raw row mean over a split

primary.formula: L_candidate = -[k log p + (R-k) log(1-p)] / R, then mean over N robots, then 0.5/0.5 over candidates, then mean over events
primary.name: V3_EVENT_EQUAL_GROUPED_BERNOULLI_NLL

second_key_probabilistic_metric.anchor: at p=0.5, k=1, R=3 the correct value is 0.25; the shortcut gives 0.02777...
second_key_probabilistic_metric.forbidden_shortcut: (p - k/R)^2 is a DIFFERENT quantity and is implemented nowhere
second_key_probabilistic_metric.formula: Brier_robot = p^2 - 2p(k/R) + k/R, then the same event-equal aggregation
second_key_probabilistic_metric.name: V3_EXPECTED_BERNOULLI_BRIER

temperature_scaling.fit_data: TRAIN-only out-of-fold predictions, after the family HP configuration is fixed

R15_calibration_policy.why: intrinsic probabilistic calibration is part of the hypothesis under test

R16_inference_bootstrap.clustering: all selected events of a sampled episode are kept together
R16_inference_bootstrap.draw_order: replicates 0..9999 in order; within a replicate, layouts consumed in ascending layout_id order; per layout one call to rng.integers(0, n_layout_episodes, size=n_layout_episodes)
R16_inference_bootstrap.paired: the SAME resample indices are used for every family within a replicate, so family differences are paired
R16_inference_bootstrap.scheme: within each VALIDATION layout, resample that layout's source episodes with replacement preserving that layout's original episode count; then pool all layouts and compute the event-equal metric on the resampled event multiset
R16_inference_bootstrap.what_it_does_not_claim: generalization to unseen layouts; that requires a later protected-domain evaluation
R16_inference_bootstrap.what_it_estimates: uncertainty over SOURCE EPISODES conditional on the frozen VALIDATION layouts
R16_inference_bootstrap.why_not_the_decision_event: up to K = 5 selected events come from ONE source trajectory and are strongly correlated; resampling events independently would understate uncertainty
R16_inference_bootstrap.zero_yield_episodes: an episode with M = 0 contributes no events and that is correct; a replicate yielding zero events overall would FAIL CLOSED
